nodes.label: Editorial Design System
nodes.rationale: A warm canvas-and-ink palette, display typography, and restrained Ember accent replace the earlier teal treatment.

nodes.label: Editorial Portfolio Home
nodes.rationale: The magazine cover owns the first viewport; fixed atmosphere and floating chrome are deliberately kept behind or outside that initial presentation.

nodes.label: Anchored Portfolio Sections
nodes.rationale: About, experience, projects, writing, education, skills, and contact use stable IDs for rail and fragment navigation.

nodes.label: Feature-Gated Floating Chrome
nodes.rationale: Social links and chatbot mount only after the cover context, preserving a clean magazine-style first view.

nodes.label: Current-Role-First Ordering
nodes.rationale: Current roles are listed before past roles to prioritize the most relevant experience.

nodes.label: Experience Detail View
nodes.rationale: A company-specific route combines role metadata, technology stack, highlights, contribution evidence, and career metrics into one experience narrative.

nodes.label: Streaming Portfolio Chat
nodes.rationale: The endpoint validates chat messages, binds a portfolio-only system context to Gemini 2.5 Flash, and streams UI messages back to the client.

nodes.label: Resume Download and Preview Delivery
nodes.rationale: The resume is offered as a direct PDF download, an external PDF view, and an eagerly loaded image preview with a loading placeholder.

nodes.label: Hysteresis Visibility Gate
nodes.rationale: Floating chrome is hidden while the cover is visible and revealed after it scrolls away; separate 40% and 55% thresholds prevent flicker, with an animation-frame-throttled scroll fallback for deterministic behavior.

nodes.label: Safe Structured Data Serialization
nodes.rationale: JSON-LD is serialized with HTML-significant characters escaped before insertion into a script element.

nodes.label: Block-Level Markdown Memoization
nodes.rationale: Markdown is parsed into blocks and each block is memoized by content, type, and tweet identifier so unchanged streamed content does not rerender.

nodes.label: Contribution Evidence Presentation
nodes.rationale: Public work exposes contribution and pull-request links, while private work substitutes compensation imagery and a disclosure explaining why code is unavailable.

nodes.label: Career Constellation
nodes.rationale: Geographic markers and arcs turn four verified engineering roles into a rotatable career narrative while the dated role list remains authoritative.

nodes.label: Selected Work Showcase
nodes.rationale: Selected work pairs compact architecture illustrations with status, period, stack, summary, and links back to verified role details.

nodes.label: External AI Profile Handoff
nodes.rationale: Visitors can open ChatGPT or Claude with the portfolio's llms.txt profile prefilled so answers remain grounded in that supplied context.

nodes.label: Piyush Kumar Professional Profile
nodes.rationale: Software engineer at Dentsu focused on GenAI services, backend systems, RAG, LLM orchestration, enterprise integration, APIs, and production automation, with earlier GPU deep-learning and backend roles.

nodes.label: Ramaiah Bachelor of Engineering
nodes.rationale: Bachelor of Engineering at Ramaiah Institute of Technology, Bengaluru, completed from 2020 to 2024 with an 8.6 CGPA.

nodes.label: Visibility-Gated Animation
nodes.rationale: Animation runs only while both the globe and browser page are visible, reducing unnecessary rendering work.

nodes.label: Reduced Motion Support
nodes.rationale: Automatic rotation and momentum are disabled when the user prefers reduced motion.

nodes.label: Section Scroll Spy
nodes.rationale: Intersection ratios identify the most visible section so the desktop contents rail reflects the reader's location.

nodes.label: Editorial Cover Pattern
nodes.rationale: The hero is designed as the front cover of the same warm editorial system used by the page body.

nodes.label: Calendar Email Fallback
nodes.rationale: When the public Cal.com link is absent, the contact section preserves a usable email scheduling path.

nodes.label: Verified Projects Only
nodes.rationale: The resume contains no standalone personal projects, so product data remains empty until verified projects are supplied.

nodes.label: Distinctive Editorial Type Kit
nodes.rationale: Fraunces, Bricolage Grotesque, and JetBrains Mono were deliberately selected to give the portfolio editorial personality and avoid generic interface typography.

nodes.label: Grounded Portfolio Answers Only
nodes.rationale: The assistant must use only listed portfolio facts and explicitly decline unavailable details to prevent invented claims.

nodes.label: 768px Mobile Breakpoint
nodes.rationale: Classifies widths below 768px as mobile and keeps the value synchronized with a media-query change listener.

nodes.label: React Query Client Context
nodes.rationale: A single QueryClient instance is lazily created per Providers component instance and exposed to descendants.

nodes.label: Forced Light Theme
nodes.rationale: The application forces light mode, disables system theme selection, and suppresses theme transition animations.

nodes.label: Global Tooltip and Toast UI
nodes.rationale: Tooltip context and two toast renderers are mounted globally around all child content.

nodes.label: Next.js Portfolio Web Stack
nodes.rationale: The personal portfolio is built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.

nodes.label: Verified-Resume Portfolio Chatbot
nodes.rationale: GEMINI_API_KEY enables a chatbot whose context is deliberately limited to verified resume information.

nodes.label: Marker–Role ID Contract
nodes.rationale: A marker id must match its role id because CSS anchors named --cobe-{id} position each floating label.

nodes.label: Resume and Globe Synchronization
nodes.rationale: Company information currently spans textual experience data and hard-coded globe coordinates, so both must be updated together.

nodes.label: Single-Source Experience Data
nodes.rationale: Coordinates could be added to experiences.ts and imported by ExperienceGlobe to remove duplicated company-location state.

nodes.label: Public Asset Path Convention
nodes.rationale: Company, resume, project, and blog media live under public; local logo values omit the leading slash because ExperienceOrgLogo adds it.

nodes.label: Accessible Hero Headshot
nodes.rationale: Replace PK initials with a priority Next Image while preserving an accessible label and matching the existing 4:5 cover aspect ratio.

nodes.label: GenAI Backend Services
nodes.author: Piyush Kumar
nodes.rationale: Python and LLM-based RAG pipelines automate summarization, contextual insight generation, and enterprise workflows.

nodes.label: Enterprise AI Orchestration
nodes.author: Piyush Kumar
nodes.rationale: LLM services are integrated with enterprise data sources and backend microservices for production use cases.

nodes.label: Identity-Resolution Workflows
nodes.author: Piyush Kumar
nodes.rationale: Schemas, retrieval logic, and identity resolution provide consistent context-rich data to LLM and analytics pipelines.

nodes.label: High-Resolution Smoke Simulation
nodes.author: Piyush Kumar
nodes.rationale: Deep-learning models and GPU training were used to improve simulation accuracy and upsampling performance.

nodes.label: Cloud-Native Delivery
nodes.author: Piyush Kumar
nodes.rationale: CI/CD automation and Kubernetes-containerized microservices support scalable deployment.

nodes.label: Warm Textured Hero Background
nodes.rationale: Uses warm material texture, soft edge shadows, and asymmetrical open space to create an atmospheric backdrop that can support foreground hero content.

nodes.label: Content Overlay Composition
nodes.rationale: The large low-detail area on the right likely preserves legibility for overlaid hero copy or controls.
